findings.finding: The queue declares this family's held sources at paths inside a custody that is not mounted in this container.
findings.treatment: All 2 digests resolved by content hash inside ../corpus-x/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1 and private/human-source-returns. Each resolved file was re-hashed from its bytes and both the declared path and the resolved path are recorded.

findings.finding: The catalog names four official forms while the source status is SOURCE_BOUND_BY_HELD_BYTES and no binary exists for the statutory forms this packet renders.
findings.treatment: The LA-STATUTORY-FORMS owner determination grants this family composition from authority of exactly LA-CCRP-ART-988, 989, 991 and 992 and lists nothing as remaining official and held. The grant is read back at build time and asserted.

findings.finding: Two of the six authoritative components are conditional and no fixture meets their conditions.
findings.treatment: Each is recorded as not generated with the record's own condition text in packet-set-manifest.json and production-field-map.json. The Article 993 supplemental-sheet route and the Article 988 fee exemption are both carried in the participant instructions so a participant on either branch is told what the record says.

findings.finding: Article 993 carries a committed legal-design statement that no template exists, none is counsel-approved and no implementation is authorized.
findings.treatment: It is not composed here. Article 993 is not in this family's authority grant and its component is conditional and unmet; the instructions send a participant with more counts than the motion holds to the clerk for the statutory sheet.

findings.finding: The Article 985 redaction paragraph is the paragraph that makes this track operable, and it is the one blank on the packet that most looks like the packet's to write.
findings.treatment: It is left blank and classified court-owned, on the committed manual-completion record's own reasoning: Article 985(C) contemplates that the order may fail to identify all locations or specify the information to be redacted and relieves the clerk of liability where it does, which is why the paragraph is the judge's. The two mover-supplied facts the paragraph needs -- who else the record names and which offices hold it -- ARE written, on the motion and again on the proposed order, so the court has them in front of the paragraph.

findings.finding: The committed memo carries two unresolved questions marked release_blocker for this track: whether a canonical source form for Articles 987 through 994 has been adopted, and whether the Article 989 motion needs a distinct pleading, prayer or election to request redaction under Article 985.
findings.treatment: Neither is answered or guessed here. The build follows the committed legal-design determination -- the Article 989 motion, the Article 991 order and the Article 992 order, with no custom pleading, because Article 986 forecloses one -- and carries both questions verbatim into participant-instructions.md and into approval-request.json for counsel. A build status is not a release.

findings.finding: The participant owns race, gender, the last four digits of the Social Security number, and the rap-sheet and agency identifiers (arrest or booking number, SID number, agency item number, driver's licence number).
findings.treatment: Every one is declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, left blank on the motion, and named verbatim in participant-instructions.md. The platform holds no Social Security number and writes none.

findings.finding: Every ordering paragraph, finding, election, date, place and judicial signature on the Article 991 and Article 992 orders belongs to the court.
findings.treatment: Each is classified court-owned, the proposed orders are visibly unexecuted, and no court or signature field carries ink.

findings.finding: The committed record holds this track's filing destination, venue, fee, fee exemption, notice, objection and service rules.
findings.treatment: Each is quoted from the record in the participant and filing instructions rather than replaced by an instruction to ask the clerk.

findings.finding: The memo holds 6 self-help stop conditions and 3 exclusions for this track.
findings.treatment: Every one is carried verbatim and numbered in participant-instructions.md, with the count printed beside them so short carriage is visible.
